fields.description: Montura 3 offers four- and five-bedroom villas within Grand Polo Club & Resort. Its launch collection contains 219 homes, with a smaller five-bedroom group alongside the four-bedroom villas. The official plans distribute living space across three levels, including upper-floor rooms and outdoor terraces.

overview: The official Montura 3 presentation centres on landscaped surroundings and the community's polo setting. A clubhouse is intended as a social hub, with outdoor recreation ranging from ball courts to garden paths and play spaces. The homes' contemporary forms sit within that wider masterplan; exact outlooks and distances to facilities depend on the selected plot.
research.locationNote: Montura 3 is part of Grand Polo Club & Resort in Dubai Investment Park 2, as identified by Property Finder. The launch sheet references access to Al Maktoum International Airport and Downtown Dubai. Verify the chosen villa's approach road and actual travel route before relying on location comparisons.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 7.07m. The phase-three fact sheet lists four-bedroom villas from AED 7.07m and five-bedroom villas from AED 9.72m. These launch references do not establish a currently available villa or include a verified breakdown of purchase costs.
research.paymentNote: The original plan comprises eight 10% stages, including booking, followed by 20% on estimated completion. Construction thresholds apply to later instalments. A purchase now requires confirmation of paid amounts, overdue balances and the remaining contractual schedule.
research.handoverNote: June 2029 is the estimated completion month on Montura 3's own payment document and Property Finder. Confirm the current programme and the conditions for possession with the developer.

facts.label: Phase-three launch mix
facts.value: 219 villas: 187 four-bedroom and 32 five-bedroom homes. The figures describe the reviewed launch release, not present inventory or a later registry total.

facts.label: Average built-up and plot areas
facts.value: The launch sheet gives four-bedroom average BUA of 3,840 sq ft on 5,088 sq ft plots, and five-bedroom average BUA of 5,137 sq ft on 5,935 sq ft plots. Individual measurements differ.

facts.label: Upper-floor uses
facts.value: The four-bedroom B Type 1 has a second-floor family room, pantry and terrace. The five-bedroom B Type 3 instead places a bedroom and study on that level, with a lift drawn through all floors. Check the selected home's lift specification and inclusions.

facts.label: Area comparison
facts.value: Total plan areas include suite, carport and balcony components. A larger published total does not necessarily mean proportionately more indoor space; compare the suite figures and layout together.
